<?php
/**
 * SecureImageProcessor - Handles image uploads with encrypted storage
 * Uses AES-256-GCM for at-rest encryption and ImageMagick for processing
 */

class CryptoStore {
    private string $key;
    private string $storagePath;

    public function __construct(string $masterKey, string $storagePath) {
        $this->key = hash('sha256', $masterKey, true);
        $this->storagePath = rtrim($storagePath, '/');
    }

    public function encrypt(string $data): string {
        $iv = random_bytes(12);
        $tag = '';
        $ciphertext = openssl_encrypt($data, 'aes-256-gcm', $this->key, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $iv, $tag);
        return base64_encode($iv . $tag . $ciphertext);
    }

    public function decrypt(string $encoded): string|false {
        $raw = base64_decode($encoded, true);
        if ($raw === false || strlen($raw) < 28) return false;
        $iv = substr($raw, 0, 12);
        $tag = substr($raw, 12, 16);
        $ciphertext = substr($raw, 28);
        return openssl_decrypt($ciphertext, 'aes-256-gcm', $this->key, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $iv, $tag);
    }

    public function store(string $id, string $data): bool {
        $encrypted = $this->encrypt($data);
        $path = $this->storagePath . '/' . $id . '.enc';
        return file_put_contents($path, $encrypted) !== false;
    }

    public function retrieve(string $id): string|false {
        $path = $this->storagePath . '/' . $id . '.enc';
        if (!file_exists($path)) return false;
        $encrypted = file_get_contents($path);
        return $this->decrypt($encrypted);
    }
}

class ImageProcessor {
    private CryptoStore $store;
    private string $tempDir;
    private array $allowedFormats = ['png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'gif', 'webp'];

    public function __construct(CryptoStore $store, string $tempDir = '/tmp/imgproc') {
        $this->store = $store;
        $this->tempDir = $tempDir;
        if (!is_dir($this->tempDir)) {
            mkdir($this->tempDir, 0700, true);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Validates image format by checking magic bytes
     */
    private function validateMagicBytes(string $data): ?string {
        $signatures = [
            'png'  => "\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n",
            'jpg'  => "\xFF\xD8\xFF",
            'gif'  => "GIF8",
            'webp' => "RIFF",
        ];
        foreach ($signatures as $format => $magic) {
            if (str_starts_with($data, $magic)) {
                return $format;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Sanitizes the output format string for use in conversion commands
     */
    private function sanitizeFormat(string $format): string {
        $clean = strtolower(trim($format));
        if (!in_array($clean, $this->allowedFormats, true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Unsupported format: ' . $clean);
        }
        return $clean;
    }

    /**
     * Builds the ImageMagick geometry string for resizing
     * Accepts WxH, W, or percentage formats
     */
    private function buildGeometry(string $dimensions): string {
        // Allow patterns like "800x600", "800", "50%"
        if (preg_match('/^\d+(%|x\d+)?$/', $dimensions)) {
            return $dimensions;
        }
        throw new InvalidArgumentException('Invalid geometry: ' . $dimensions);
    }

    /**
     * Generates a safe temporary filename
     */
    private function tempFile(string $ext): string {
        return $this->tempDir . '/' . bin2hex(random_bytes(16)) . '.' . $ext;
    }

    /**
     * Process an uploaded image: validate, resize, convert, encrypt, store
     * 
     * @param string $imageData Raw image binary data
     * @param string $targetFormat Desired output format
     * @param string $geometry Resize dimensions
     * @param array $metadata Additional processing metadata
     * @return string|false The storage ID on success
     */
    public function processAndStore(
        string $imageData,
        string $targetFormat,
        string $geometry,
        array $metadata = []
    ): string|false {
        // Step 1: Validate magic bytes
        $detectedFormat = $this->validateMagicBytes($imageData);
        if ($detectedFormat === null) {
            error_log('Image validation failed: unrecognized format');
            return false;
        }

        // Step 2: Sanitize target format
        $outputFormat = $this->sanitizeFormat($targetFormat);

        // Step 3: Validate geometry
        $safeGeometry = $this->buildGeometry($geometry);

        // Step 4: Write to temp file for processing
        $inputFile = $this->tempFile($detectedFormat);
        file_put_contents($inputFile, $imageData);

        // Step 5: Build output path
        $outputFile = $this->tempFile($outputFormat);

        // Step 6: Build and execute conversion command
        $result = $this->executeConversion($inputFile, $outputFile, $safeGeometry, $metadata);

        // Step 7: Cleanup input
        @unlink($inputFile);

        if (!$result) {
            @unlink($outputFile);
            return false;
        }

        // Step 8: Read processed image and encrypt-store
        $processedData = file_get_contents($outputFile);
        @unlink($outputFile);

        if ($processedData === false) return false;

        $storageId = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        if ($this->store->store($storageId, $processedData)) {
            return $storageId;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Executes the ImageMagick convert command with all parameters
     */
    private function executeConversion(
        string $input,
        string $output,
        string $geometry,
        array $metadata
    ): bool {
        // Build base command with escapeshellarg for file paths
        $cmd = 'convert ' . escapeshellarg($input);
        $cmd .= ' -resize ' . escapeshellarg($geometry);
        $cmd .= ' -strip'; // Remove EXIF for privacy

        // Apply color profile if specified in metadata
        if (isset($metadata['profile'])) {
            $profileName = $this->resolveColorProfile($metadata['profile']);
            if ($profileName !== null) {
                $cmd .= ' -profile ' . escapeshellarg($profileName);
            }
        }

        // Apply quality setting
        $quality = $metadata['quality'] ?? 85;
        $cmd .= ' -quality ' . intval($quality);

        // Apply comment annotation if provided
        if (isset($metadata['comment'])) {
            $cmd .= ' -set comment ' . $this->escapeAnnotation($metadata['comment']);
        }

        $cmd .= ' ' . escapeshellarg($output);

        $returnCode = 0;
        $cmdOutput = [];
        exec($cmd, $cmdOutput, $returnCode);

        return $returnCode === 0;
    }

    /**
     * Resolves a color profile name to its system path
     */
    private function resolveColorProfile(string $name): ?string {
        $profiles = [
            'srgb' => '/usr/share/color/icc/sRGB.icc',
            'adobergb' => '/usr/share/color/icc/AdobeRGB1998.icc',
            'cmyk' => '/usr/share/color/icc/USWebCoatedSWOP.icc',
        ];
        $key = strtolower(trim($name));
        return $profiles[$key] ?? null;
    }

    /**
     * Escapes annotation text for ImageMagick comment fields.
     * ImageMagick comments support special sequences, so we use
     * a targeted escaping approach that preserves valid content
     * while neutralizing shell metacharacters.
     */
    private function escapeAnnotation(string $text): string {
        // Limit length to prevent buffer issues
        $text = substr($text, 0, 256);
        // Remove null bytes
        $text = str_replace("\x00", '', $text);
        // Escape using single quotes with proper handling
        // We replace single quotes with '\'' (end quote, escaped quote, start quote)
        $escaped = str_replace("'", "'\\''", $text);
        return "'" . $escaped . "'";
    }
}

// Application entry point
function handleImageUpload(array $request): array {
    $config = [
        'master_key' => getenv('ENCRYPTION_KEY') ?: 'default-dev-key-change-in-prod',
        'storage_path' => getenv('STORAGE_PATH') ?: '/var/data/encrypted_images',
        'temp_dir' => getenv('TEMP_DIR') ?: '/tmp/imgproc',
    ];

    $store = new CryptoStore($config['master_key'], $config['storage_path']);
    $processor = new ImageProcessor($store, $config['temp_dir']);

    // Validate request
    if (empty($request['image_data'])) {
        return ['error' => 'No image data provided', 'code' => 400];
    }

    $imageData = base64_decode($request['image_data'], true);
    if ($imageData === false) {
        return ['error' => 'Invalid base64 encoding', 'code' => 400];
    }

    $format = $request['format'] ?? 'png';
    $geometry = $request['geometry'] ?? '800x600';
    $metadata = $request['metadata'] ?? [];

    try {
        $storageId = $processor->processAndStore($imageData, $format, $geometry, $metadata);
        if ($storageId === false) {
            return ['error' => 'Processing failed', 'code' => 500];
        }
        return ['storage_id' => $storageId, 'code' => 200];
    } catch (InvalidArgumentException $e) {
        return ['error' => $e->getMessage(), 'code' => 400];
    }
}
